title: P0.24: Build-State Sovereignty + Live Runtime Contract
description: The user tested IABV v1.5 expecting P0.22/P0.23 fixes (#400/#401) to be active, but runtime_audit.jsonl showed HEAD 901fa7629 (P0.21 stale build). This invalidated the live proof: browser_security_verification, NoneType.get, misrouting of 'chat gpt/chatgo' to local chat, and UI stall 36.5s all occurred under stale code that lacked the fixes. P0.24 adds build-state sovereignty gates and a live runtime contract to prevent testing against stale builds.
reason: Root cause: the Windows runtime loaded a stale workspace (HEAD 901fa7629 / P0.21) instead of the merged P0.22 code (cdf97a63) or the P0.23 branch. _REQUIRED_FEATURE_MARKERS only checked for P0.21-era markers, not P0.22/_should_defer_heavy_work or P0.23/_ASSISTANT_ALIASES. No typed trace methods existed for stale_build_detected, live_proof_started, or live_proof_result. validate_live_proof_terminal did not exist to validate whether a dispatch terminal was acceptable for live proof.
next_action: Live proof on Windows: (1) merge PR #401 (P0.23) and this PR (P0.24), (2) verify runtime_audit.jsonl shows runtime_build_fingerprint with has_p022_consultation_state=true and has_p023_external_intent_security=true, (3) if stale_build_detected appears, update workspace to correct HEAD, (4) write 'consulta nueva a ChatGPT: responde solo S si entiendes', (5) terminal must be response_captured, blocked_by_security_verification, or blocked_by_resource_pressure.
resume_hint: P0.24 code applied: _REQUIRED_FEATURE_MARKERS expanded with has_p022_consultation_state and has_p023_external_intent_security. _MARKER_FILES includes assistant_preference_resolver.py. RuntimeAuditTracer has typed trace_stale_build_detected(), trace_live_proof_started(), trace_live_proof_result(). Module-level validate_live_proof_terminal() validates dispatch terminals against live-proof contract. Bootstrap stores _build_fingerprint_data and calls trace_stale_build_detected() instead of generic trace(). P0.23 trace_event() calls fixed to trace().

metadata.root_cause: Stale build: Windows runtime ran HEAD 901fa7629 (P0.21) instead of P0.22 (cdf97a63) or P0.23 branch. Feature markers only checked P0.21-era code. No build-state gate to warn or block live proof on stale builds. No typed trace methods for stale detection or live-proof lifecycle. P0.23 used nonexistent trace_event() method instead of trace().
